svg.title: IUS business fundraising letter - re-typeset study
svg.desc: Source-derived re-typesetting of the visible $100 business appeal and address. Font audit v1.1 restores the italic display headlines with Nimbus Roman Bold Italic outlines; questions and body remain upright. Line breaks and exact typeface are reconstructed; obscured salutation and signature are omitted. Historical address and amounts are documentary content, not a current donation request. US Letter canvas is nominal.

g.title: Interior University Society - vertical stationery mark
g.desc: The print reconstruction rotated minus 90 degrees to reproduce the orientation visible on the original letterhead. Transparent background; outlined lettering.

g.aria-label: What will we do with your $100 ?
Your business cheque for $100 together with other businesses will help the
campaign to get a University for the Interior. The enclosed brochure sets out our
objectives, but we need your support now.
